citation: Weems, R.E., Lemon, E.M., and Nelson, M.S., 1997, Geology of the Pringletown, Ridgeville, Summerville, and Summerville Northwest 7.5-minute quadrangles, Berkeley, Charleston, and Dorcester Counties, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Miscellaneous Geologic Investigations Map I-2502, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Pamphlet pages 1-9 have a good text layer. Plate pages 13-15 are OCR of map sheets: the description of map units is jumbled across columns and several unit headings are garbled (Parkers Ferry, Rudd Branch, Wando facies); values assigned to units from that jumbled text are flagged inferred. Figure 4 auger-hole logs are unreadable except the header labels and elevations (paired by column order, inferred). Wando facies thicknesses skipped (facies headings lost). Pages 10-12 absent from packet. References outside SC geology (Barrett, Berggren, Clark and Miller, Goddard, Martini, Shackleton and Opdyke, Thornbury, Richardson, Lyell, Brunswig, Cronin, DuBar) skipped.
